title: Presenting, Describing, and Summarizing
summary: Presenting artwork, summarizing information, and adding new information clearly.
whyItMatters: A clear presentation guides listeners from context through selected details to interpretation and a concise conclusion.

mentalModel.title: Orient, describe, interpret, summarize
mentalModel.content: Give the audience a map before details and distinguish observation from interpretation.

mentalModel.title: Select rather than repeat
mentalModel.content: A summary preserves the central message, strongest evidence, and relevant conclusion.

ruleBlocks.title: State topic and route
ruleBlocks.content: Name the subject, purpose, and two or three sections.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe evidence before meaning
ruleBlocks.content: Use position, color, material, process, and visible details before interpretation.

ruleBlocks.title: Add information explicitly
ruleBlocks.content: Use außerdem, darüber hinaus, hinzu kommt, dass, and besonders wichtig ist.

ruleBlocks.title: Compress the main message
ruleBlocks.content: Restate the central point without introducing unrelated new detail.

comparisons.summary: The theme provides varied content for process and object presentations.
Passive forms support factual descriptions of creation and institutional processes.

examples.de: Heute möchte ich ein Wandbild vorstellen, das 2024 in Berlin entstanden ist.
examples.en: Today I would like to present a mural created in Berlin in 2024.

examples.de: Im Mittelpunkt sieht man zwei Figuren, die durch eine Brücke verbunden sind.
examples.en: In the center, one sees two figures connected by a bridge.

examples.de: Die Brücke könnte für Zusammenarbeit und Vertrauen stehen.
examples.en: The bridge could stand for cooperation and trust.

examples.de: Darüber hinaus wurde das Werk gemeinsam mit Jugendlichen gestaltet.
examples.en: In addition, the work was designed together with young people.

examples.de: Zusammenfassend verbindet das Projekt Kunst mit gesellschaftlicher Beteiligung.
examples.en: In summary, the project connects art with social participation.

commonMistakes.correct: Select details that support the presentation's central point.

commonMistakes.reason: Interpretations should be identified as such.

commonMistakes.correct: Summarize the message and invite questions.

tips: Limit the structure to three main sections.
